wstep: There is no recipe here for Provençal tapenade, a paste of black or green olives with capers. [T:-]

ostrzezenia.tekst: There are no validated processes for vegetables and herbs in oil made at home; in the USA, the rules for such products apply only to commercial processors. [T:OLE-028]

According to ANSES, the French food safety agency, the foods that most often cause botulism include canned vegetables, such as peppers, asparagus, Greek-style olives and tapenade, and canned meat, such as terrine and pâté, usually homemade or artisanal. [T:OLE-046]

In France in September 2011, two family botulism outbreaks (type A toxin) were traced to a ground green olive paste from an artisanal producer; incorrect sterilization techniques were observed at the producer's workshop. [T:OLE-049]
